scientific_integrity: The first-weight spectrum and general numerical distance formulas are acknowledged prior work. New content is exact classification and multiplicities of all optimal higher-dimensional linear-section systems. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts rational points on the dense torus of the cubic scroll for prime powers at least 5; nonoptimal linear sections and toric boundary points are outside scope. Historical priority is provisional. Exhaustive computational verification covers only fields of order 5 and 7, alongside an all-field algebraic proof.
title: Optimal higher-support linear sections of the cubic scroll torus
